result_statement: For a literal original-coordinate 3x2 cross block C of rank two, with P the 3x3 same-side physical block, unit null vector n of C^T, Delta=sqrt(det(C^T C)), exact kernel curvature n^T P n=0 and nonzero shear p=(I-nn^T)Pn, the full ambient quadratic form has a continuous density bounded by [5*6^(3/5)/2^(13/10)] Delta^(-2/5)||p||^(-1/5). Equivalently, for w equal to the cross product of the two columns of C, the bound is C_sh (||w||||Pw||)^(-1/5). Arbitrary same-side curvature on the opposite bank, outside couplings, affine terms, signs and extra spectrum are retained.
proof_mechanism: Condition outside original coordinates; analytically resolve the 3x2 left kernel; at zero kernel curvature the fiber phase is linear with a moving frequency. Use Hausdorff-Young for an L4-in-time fiber budget, the source-valid two-dimensional slope projection cap and one-dimensional moving-frequency projection cap, then two-dimensional bilinear Plancherel and Holder to obtain an L1 characteristic function.
